steps.title: Cru can take you to things in Crundi
steps.body: Talking to Cru on the PC app or the web, ask it to show you something: a card on the board, a chat, a file, a setting. It switches project and tab, opens what you asked for, and rings it with a short note. It is the page you are talking from that moves, never another screen; on the phone Cru shows you a card instead.

keys.text: Cru goes there and points at it

steps.title: Cru's replies can show pictures, files and data
steps.body: In Cru's conversation, a reply can now carry pictures, video and audio players, files to download, live frames such as a chart or a video link, and cards with tables, lists and progress. They stay in the conversation where Cru showed them, on the web, the PC app and the phone.

steps.title: A chat's pictures as a gallery
steps.body: Open a picture in a chat and move through all of that chat's pictures: swipe on the phone, or the side buttons and the arrow keys on the PC. Zoom in as before; a swipe moves on only when you are not zoomed in.

steps.title: Mute Cru's voice
steps.body: The voice screen's menu has Mute Cru's voice: Cru answers in text only until you unmute it, on this device. And when your last message was typed, what Cru says on its own is shown, not spoken.

steps.title: Take back a queued phrase
steps.body: Something you said while Cru was still answering waits as a faded bubble. Its X drops just that phrase before Cru hears it; the answer in progress carries on.

steps.title: Cru's full view, back again
steps.body: Left Cru's full-screen view with Normal view? The expand button on its panel puts it back over the whole screen.
